Question: What guidelines were issued by IRDAI on 28 February 2023 regarding terminology in health insurance regulations?

Reference answer: IRDAI issued guidelines on 28 February 2023 to modify the terminology “sub-standard lives” mentioned in the IRDAI (Health Insurance) Regulations-2016.
Key facts from the source rule: IRDAI/HLT/CIR/MISC/59/2/2023 dated 28.02.2023 Modification of the terminology “sub-standard lives” mentioned in IRDAI ( Health Insurance ) Regulations-2016
